name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem in a project, service, or documentation.
title: ""
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Affected surface

Project/route, public site or local setup, browser/device, and commit or deployment date when known. Identify whether this is the static site, Next.js / FastAPI, Osiris runtime, MCP host, or documentation.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest steps and synthetic input needed to reproduce the problem.

## Expected and actual behavior

Describe each separately. Include a sanitized screenshot or error message when useful.

## Checks already tried

Include relevant commands and results. For AI issues, identify the connection mode and whether the problem happens before sign-in, after sign-in, or during a request. Do not include account credentials or private prompts.

**Security:** do not post secrets, private records, or vulnerability details. Follow [Security](https://github.com/Ballzatram/ballzatram/blob/master/SECURITY.md) for private reporting.
